correctness.rationale: Circular gap decomposition is exact for n≥3 and r<1/2. Exponential normalization couples long gaps to Bin(n,c/√n) with O_P(log n) discrepancy, negligible relative to n^{1/4}; conditional uniform compositions give fixed factorial moment convergence to Poisson(c²) for every h~c√n, establishing asymptotic independence. Dirichlet gap probabilities give exact mixed moments and a 2c² covariance limit. The packaged 1048 assertions corroborate finite components; all-order proof is analytic.

originality.rationale: The original assertion is the joint mixed-scale Gaussian–Poisson limit with nonzero residual covariance, not Huillet 2003 known finite conditional component-size distribution. Huillet Section 5 addresses bounded gap counts and linear-count Gaussian cases, not the √n regime; neighboring references are distinct sampling laws, dimensions or marginal targets. A 1984 full-text priority risk is explicitly retained.
residual_risks: Holst–Hüsler 1984 full text inaccessible after public and lawful full-text retrieval attempts; its abstract does not establish or exclude an implicit singleton-count joint limit.
Zhao–Yağan–Gligor 2015 and Penrose 2018 full texts were not accessed; only their abstracts and metadata inspected.

Huillet 2003 exact finite joint component-size distribution could allow the result to be reconstructed as an unstated asymptotic consequence; the novelty is the proved critical-window joint law, not those underlying formulas.
